name: week-calendar
description: Weekly calendar and agent-effectiveness report of Claude Code sessions: PRs merged and productive agent time per machine, published to a team repo

machineName.title: Machine name
machineName.description: Name of this agent PC in team reports. Empty: the computer name.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: Who runs this PC. Empty: your global git user.name.

availableHoursPerWeek.title: Available hours per week
availableHoursPerWeek.description: Hours this PC is available to agents each week; 168 for a dedicated PC.

reportsRepoUrl.title: Reports repo
reportsRepoUrl.description: Git URL of the team's agent-reports repo.

ignoreFolders.title: Ignored folders
ignoreFolders.description: Comma-separated folder fragments whose sessions are left out (temp benchmarks, scratch).

githubLogin.title: GitHub login
githubLogin.description: Your GitHub username, to tell your merged PRs from teammates' PRs you committed to. Empty: the account gh is signed in as.

gitEmails.title: Extra git emails
gitEmails.description: Comma-separated commit emails that count as this PC's (e.g. the AI agent account), beside each repo's user.email.
